title: Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves

existingInline.scene: Ali Baba hides in a tree as the mounted thieves arrive at the rock face and their chief opens the hidden entrance.

images.scene: Ali Baba hides in a tree as the mounted thieves arrive at the rock face and their chief opens the hidden entrance.

After the thieves leave, Ali Baba opens the cave and discovers heaps of gold coins, silver coins and folded beautiful cloth; outside, he takes only three sacks of gold and loads them onto his three donkeys.
In a peaceful Persian courtyard, Ali Baba warmly welcomes Morgiana and his son into the family; the three share a quiet meal and a modest pouch of treasure rests nearby, suggesting their new life.
